instruction: Save this as an actual GIMP project file named project.xcf on the Desktop — not an exported copy, the editable project itself.

criteria.script: async () => { const data = await window.surfgym.get_configs({ criteria: [ { file: 'Desktop/project.xcf', format: 'file_magic', offset: 0, length: 8, default: '' } ] }); return data[0]; }
